defaultEntry.trigger: ordinary natural-language durable task or explicit meta-theory shortcut

fitnessInformedDefaultApplicationPolicy.coreRule: Critical, Fetch, and Thinking remain the ordering and truth boundary, but a clear low-risk local task uses concise inline records and no extra governance worker, planning artifact, or route ceremony unless ambiguity, capability choice, dependency, risk, or durable planning changes execution.
reviewTriggers: security, permissions, privacy, auth, payment, dependency, runtime, install, release, public-ready, or cross-platform claim
fresh verification exposes a failure, regression, or unresolved trade-off
evolutionTriggers: reusable capability gap or repeated failure scar
agent, skill, tool, MCP, hook, workflow, runtime, OS, or governance-contract lesson must survive the run
user explicitly requests durable learning or evolution
fitnessInformedDefaultApplicationPolicy.noTriggerRule: When no Evolution trigger exists, close inline with none-with-reason; do not dispatch meta-chrysalis or run candidate-analysis lanes.
fitnessInformedDefaultApplicationPolicy.truthBoundary: Cost-only evidence can justify conditional or default removal policy, but it never proves a quality benefit and never deletes a canonical stage or runtime capability.

parallelExecutionPolicy.authority: This contract is the single machine authority for stage order, stage barriers, stage-internal parallelism, and final stage authority. Skills, references, runners, adapters, and hooks are projections or consumers and must not define a competing wave model.
parallelExecutionPolicy.stageBarrierRule: No lane in the next stage may start until the current stage merge node has completed. Cross-stage overlap is forbidden; parallelism is maximized inside the active stage.
parallelExecutionPolicy.laneReadinessRule: Run every ready lane up to active host capacity when its dependencies are complete, its resource scopes do not conflict with another ready lane, its permission boundary is satisfied, and dispatch plus merge overhead is justified.
parallelExecutionPolicy.resourceRule: Unknown write scope is unsafe for parallel mutation. Same-file, same-state, same-port, same-service, or same external-resource writes serialize unless verified isolation and an explicit merge contract remove the conflict.
parallelExecutionPolicy.sideEffectRule: Read-only support lanes may fan out by default. Project writes require bounded resource scopes and collision policy. External or irreversible writes require the applicable approval before invocation and remain serialized unless approved, disjoint, isolated, and idempotent.
parallelExecutionPolicy.capacityRule: Use the active runtime capacity; Meta_Kim must not impose an arbitrary fixed lane or wave count.
parallelExecutionPolicy.mergeRule: Each stage has one merge or verdict authority. Support lanes may prepare evidence and recommendations, but only that authority closes the stage outputs and releases the next-stage barrier.
parallelExecutionPolicy.invocationTruthRule: A planned lane, derived wave, selected provider, host invocation request, or dispatched label is not execution evidence. Completion requires an exact run-and-lane-bound native host call and successful terminal result; claimed concurrency additionally requires batched native calls or overlapping invocation intervals.
parallelExecutionPolicy.degradationRule: Unavailable capacity, permission, isolation, owner, or host surface may produce an explicit partial or degraded route. Degradation must not be relabeled as parallel execution, completion, verification pass, or public-ready.
